abilities.name: Structure
abilities.text: This Unit cannot be Activated in any Phase and cannot perform actions. Its Current Supply Value is treated as 0, and it can never Control or Contest Mission Markers, ignoring the standard Zero Supply Exception. This Unit cannot be a target of an ability, unless stated otherwise.

abilities.name: Warp Conduit
abilities.text: Once per Round, the controlling player may deploy a Ground Unit from the Reserves using this Pylon base as the Entry Edge. This Unit's Activation ends.

abilities.name: Bloodshard Monument
abilities.text: When the Current Supply Value of a Unit Within 8″ is reduced, return one non-Unique Exhausted Tactical Card to the Ready state.

abilities.name: Overwatch
abilities.text: When an Enemy Unit ends its Activation Within 8″, this Unit immediately performs a Ranged Attack against that Enemy Unit.
